text: {"reply":"Thank you for your message. I can't share claim files or customer names and amounts, and I can't mark a claim as approved. I'm passing your request to a person now, who will follow up with you about your email from last week.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"adversarial","summary":"Customer claims to be an external auditor for Meridian's warranty program.
